title: 四级听力 · Section A 短篇新闻（3 篇）

questions.stem: What do volunteers do with the broken bicycles?
options: They sell them to local shops.
They repair them and use them as mobile libraries.
They send them to recycling centers abroad.
They give them to school children.
questions.explain: 原文：Volunteers collect broken bicycles from recycling centers and repair them with parts donated by local shops. Each repaired bike carries a small metal box filled with books. —— 修好后当流动图书馆用，故选 B。A 的 shops 只是捐零件，不是买主。
questions.transcript: Volunteers collect broken bicycles from recycling centers and repair them with parts donated by local shops. Each repaired bike carries a small metal box filled with books.

questions.stem: What is one aim of the program?
options: To reduce the number of bicycles sent to landfills.
To sell more books in the city.
To train volunteers as mechanics.
To make the city's buses more popular.
questions.explain: 原文结尾：City officials say they hope the program will encourage people to read while they travel, and reduce the number of bicycles that end up in landfills. —— A 直接对应。
questions.transcript: City officials say they hope the program will encourage people to read while they travel, and reduce the number of bicycles that end up in landfills.

questions.stem: What did the study find about workers who walked after lunch?
options: They took longer lunch breaks.
They made fewer mistakes in the afternoon.
They earned more money.
They slept better at night.
questions.explain: 原文：The group that walked for fifteen minutes reported fewer headaches and made fewer mistakes in the afternoon. —— 直接给出 B。
questions.transcript: The group that walked for fifteen minutes reported fewer headaches and made fewer mistakes in the afternoon.

questions.stem: What limitation of the study is mentioned?
options: The study lasted only one month.
Only two hundred people took part.
The result may not apply to workers doing heavy physical labor.
The company refused to publish the data.
questions.explain: 原文：The researchers warn that the result may not apply to workers who do heavy physical labor. —— 这是研究者自己指出的适用范围限制，选 C。
questions.transcript: The researchers warn that the result may not apply to workers who do heavy physical labor.

questions.stem: What happened at the airport?
options: A strike stopped all flights.
More than ninety flights were cancelled because of snow.
A new runway was opened.
All passengers were sent home.
questions.explain: 原文：A heavy snowstorm has forced the airport of a northern city to cancel more than ninety flights. —— B 是对该句的同义转述。
questions.transcript: A heavy snowstorm has forced the airport of a northern city to cancel more than ninety flights.

questions.stem: When is normal service expected to return?
options: By Thursday evening.
By Friday morning.
By Saturday afternoon.
By Sunday morning.
questions.explain: 原文最后一句：the airport said that normal service should return by Saturday afternoon. —— 时间题，抓 Saturday afternoon。
questions.transcript: The airport said that normal service should return by Saturday afternoon.

questions.stem: Why can the woman open a student account?
options: She works at the bank.
She is a second-year university student.
Her parents have an account there.
She lives near the bank.
questions.explain: 原文：Certainly, are you a student at the university? Yes, I am in my second year. Then you can open a student account. —— 身份是开学生账户的依据，选 B。
questions.transcript: Are you a student at the university? Yes, I am in my second year. Then you can open a student account.

questions.stem: What document does the woman still need to bring?
options: Her passport.
A letter from the university confirming her address.
A bank statement.
Her travel card.
questions.explain: 原文：You will need your student card and a letter from the university confirming your address. I have my student card here, but I did not know about the letter. —— 已有学生证，还差地址证明信，选 B。
questions.transcript: You will need your student card and a letter from the university confirming your address.

questions.stem: What happens if she keeps more than five hundred pounds in the account?
options: She receives a small amount of interest each year.
She has to pay a monthly fee.
She gets a free travel card.
She can transfer money abroad for free.
questions.explain: 原文：if you keep more than five hundred pounds in the account, you will receive a small amount of interest each year. —— 选 A。注意免费旅行卡是学生账户本身附带的，不是这个条件触发的。
questions.transcript: If you keep more than five hundred pounds in the account, you will receive a small amount of interest each year.

questions.stem: How much is charged for a transfer from abroad?
options: Nothing.
Five pounds.
Eight pounds.
Ten pounds.
questions.explain: 原文：there is a charge of eight pounds for each transfer from outside the country. —— 数字题，选 C。
questions.transcript: There is a charge of eight pounds for each transfer from outside the country.

questions.stem: What is the woman trying to find?
options: The city library.
The new sports centre.
A swimming competition.
The university roundabout.
questions.explain: 原文开头：Excuse me, I am looking for the new sports centre. —— 选 B。图书馆只是路标。
questions.transcript: Excuse me, I am looking for the new sports centre.

questions.stem: Why is the swimming pool closed this morning?
options: It is being cleaned.
Students have a competition there.
The water is too cold.
It opens only in the afternoon.
questions.explain: 原文：the swimming pool is closed until four o'clock because the students have a competition this morning. —— 选 B。
questions.transcript: The swimming pool is closed until four o'clock because the students have a competition this morning.

questions.stem: When is the pool usually quiet?
options: Between six and eight in the evening.
After eight in the evening.
Early in the morning.
At lunchtime.
questions.explain: 原文：Quite busy between six and eight, but it is usually quiet after eight. —— 注意转折词 but 之后才是答案，选 B。
questions.transcript: Quite busy between six and eight, but it is usually quiet after eight.

questions.stem: How should the woman book a tennis court?
options: By telephoning the manager.
At least a day ahead, at the desk or on the website.
On the same day at the entrance.
By asking a student member.
questions.explain: 原文：for the tennis courts you should book at least a day ahead, either at the desk or on the website. —— 选 B。
questions.transcript: For the tennis courts you should book at least a day ahead, either at the desk or on the website.

questions.stem: What happens during deep sleep?
options: The body repairs muscles and strengthens the immune system.
Most dreaming takes place.
The brain is as active as when we are awake.
New memories are sorted and stored.
questions.explain: 原文：In deep sleep the body repairs muscles and strengthens the immune system. —— B、C、D 都是快速眼动睡眠的特征，属张冠李戴型干扰项。
questions.transcript: In deep sleep the body repairs muscles and strengthens the immune system.

questions.stem: What is special about rapid eye movement sleep?
options: The body temperature drops sharply.
The brain is almost as active as when we are awake.
It lasts only a few seconds.
It happens only in the early evening.
questions.explain: 原文：In the stage known as rapid eye movement sleep, the brain is almost as active as when we are awake. —— 选 B。
questions.transcript: In the stage known as rapid eye movement sleep, the brain is almost as active as when we are awake.

questions.stem: Why does catching up on sleep at the weekend not fully work?
options: The brain cannot store the missing stages in a single long night.
People usually wake up too early at weekends.
Weekend sleep is always interrupted.
The body needs less sleep as it gets older.
questions.explain: 原文：this pattern does not fully repair the damage, because the brain cannot store the missing stages in a single long night. —— 因果关系要抓 because 后的内容。
questions.transcript: Research suggests that this pattern does not fully repair the damage, because the brain cannot store the missing stages in a single long night.

questions.stem: What problem do park managers face?
options: How to attract more visitors.
How to let people enjoy a place without damaging it.
How to train enough bus drivers.
How to raise money for new car parks.
questions.explain: 原文：every year park managers face the same problem, how to let people enjoy a place without damaging it. —— 同位语直接给出答案，选 B。
questions.transcript: Every year park managers face the same problem, how to let people enjoy a place without damaging it.

questions.stem: What has the shuttle bus system achieved?
options: It has doubled the number of visitors.
It has reduced traffic inside the parks by more than half.
It has made the parks free to enter.
It has shortened the opening hours.
questions.explain: 原文：The system has reduced traffic inside the parks by more than half, and the air is noticeably cleaner. —— 选 B。
questions.transcript: The system has reduced traffic inside the parks by more than half, and the air is noticeably cleaner.

questions.stem: What complaint do some visitors make?
options: The buses are too expensive.
The buses are crowded and they cannot reach quiet corners.
The car park is too far from the park.
The drivers are unfriendly.
questions.explain: 原文：Some visitors say the buses are crowded in summer, and that they cannot reach the quiet corners they used to drive to. —— 两条抱怨并列，B 完整覆盖。
questions.transcript: Some visitors say the buses are crowded in summer, and that they cannot reach the quiet corners they used to drive to.

questions.stem: What did Carnegie require towns to do?
options: To name the library after him.
To provide the land and pay for books and staff from local taxes.
To build the library within one year.
To employ only local workers.
questions.explain: 原文：He asked each town to provide the land and to promise to pay for the books and the staff from local taxes. —— 选 B。
questions.transcript: He asked each town to provide the land and to promise to pay for the books and the staff from local taxes.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker say the conditions were important?
options: They saved Carnegie a lot of money.
They made local governments treat libraries as a permanent public service.
They prevented libraries from being enlarged.
They attracted more foreign donations.
questions.explain: 原文：the conditions he attached were as important as the money, because they taught local governments to treat libraries as a permanent public service rather than a temporary charity. —— 选 B。
questions.transcript: Historians say that the conditions he attached were as important as the money, because they taught local governments to treat libraries as a permanent public service rather than a temporary charity.
